compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Labour Act, SSF and minimum-wage checks for your organization — what's done and what needs action.
compliance.forbidden: Only owners, admins and HR can see compliance.
compliance.disclaimer: KaamSathi prepares files and reminders to help you comply; it is not legal advice. Contract templates should be reviewed with a labour lawyer.

score.title: Compliance score
score.description: Based on the checks on this page.
score.count_action: {count, plural, =0 {No actions} one {# action} other {# actions}}
score.count_warning: {count, plural, =0 {No warnings} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}

items.title: Action items
items.description: Fix the red items first — they carry legal risk.

credentials.title: Certificates expiring soon
credentials.description: Worker certificates (NSTB, licences, safety) expiring in the next 30 days.
credentials.none: No certificates expire in the next 30 days.

ssf.title: SSF filings
ssf.description: Monthly Social Security Fund contribution files (11% worker + 20% employer). Download, upload to the SSF portal, then record the receipt.
ssf.empty_body: Approve a payroll run to prepare its SSF contribution file.
ssf.missing_ids: {count, plural, one {# without SSF ID} other {# without SSF ID}}
ssf.how: Due date = end of the BS month + 15 days. Workers without an SSF ID are listed on a separate sheet — register them on the SSF portal first.
ssf.submit_body: Record when you uploaded the file to the SSF portal. Add the receipt number once SSF acknowledges it.
ssf.receipt_hint: Leave empty if you have not received it yet.

contract.title: Appointment letter (contract)
contract.description: Bilingual letter with Labour Act 2074 essentials — wages, hours, leave, SSF, notice.
contract.empty_body: Generate an appointment letter from this worker's current terms. The worker can accept it in the KaamSathi app.
contract.terms_changed: Wage, designation or site changed since the last version.
contract.waiting_body: Waiting for the worker to accept in the app. Signed on paper? Record it here.
contract.lawyer_note: Template — review with a labour lawyer before relying on it.

contractors.title: Contractors (Thekedar)
contractors.description: Labour contractors who supply workers, with headcount, days and wages per BS month.
contractors.empty_body: Add a thekedar to track the workers they supply and what they cost each month.
contractors.dialog_body: The contractor's own workers stay your employees on KaamSathi — this only groups them.
contractors.name: Contractor / company name
contractors.trades_hint: What kind of workers they supply.
contractors.no_payroll: No payroll run for this month yet.
contractors.workers_body: Active workers supplied by this contractor.
contractors.assigned_toast: {count, plural, one {# worker assigned} other {# workers assigned}}
contractors.assign_body: Pick the workers this contractor supplied. A worker belongs to one contractor at a time.
